name: sk-design
description: Design-family parent hub: the single advisor-routable home for distinctive, intentional UI design and the full design surface. Routes any design query to two workflow modes via mode-registry.json (interface: visual direction, taste, and interface build judgment, plus the static visual system — color, typography, layout, spacing, hierarchy, design tokens, theming — the temporal/motion layer — animation, transitions, micro-interactions, reduced motion — and the anti-slop / accessibility / production-hardening pre-delivery gate; md-generator: extract a live site's real CSS into a v3 Style Reference DESIGN.md via an embedded Playwright pipeline). The hub holds no per-mode logic; each mode keeps its own contract and cites the shared design reference base.
